Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks close lower as oil prices jump, indexes notch monthly gains
Markets.summary: US stocks closed lower on Monday as surging oil prices and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh revived inflation concerns. Despite the daily decline, major indexes still finished August with monthly gains.

Markets.title: US SEC chairman moves to give states power over shareholder resolutions
Markets.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is considering rule changes that would give states power over shareholder resolutions and potentially increase ownership requirements for filing them. This shift could reduce investor activist influence and create non-uniform regulations across states.

Markets.title: JP Morgan traders back down bullishness on US stocks after Fed chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech
Markets.summary: JPMorgan traders have turned tactically cautious on US stocks for the coming weeks following Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's hawkish comments on interest rates at Jackson Hole. They cite ongoing uncertainty over the rate outlook and the potential unwinding of artificial intelligence stocks as key risks to the market.

Markets.title: US 10-year Treasury yield tops 19-month high as oil prices fuel rate-hike bets
Markets.summary: US 10-year Treasury yields surpassed 4.75 percent, reaching a 19-month high amid rising oil prices and inflation-driven rate-hike expectations. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh signaled potential action to control inflation, prompting investors to closely monitor upcoming economic data.

Markets.title: Longer-dated US Treasury yields climb as Iran and US restart military attacks
Markets.summary: Longer-dated US Treasury yields climbed as escalating US-Iran hostilities pushed crude oil prices higher and fueled inflation concerns. Consequently, investors began anticipating a potential September interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve, influenced by comments from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

Markets.title: ITC Infotech to merge with Happiest Minds, buy 22% promoter stake for Rs 1,330 crore
Markets.summary: ITC Infotech is acquiring a 22% promoter stake in Happiest Minds Technologies for Rs 1,330 crore and merging with the company. The combined entity will become India's eleventh largest listed IT services player by revenue with the goal of creating an AI-first enterprise by FY28.

Geo-Political.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
Geo-Political.summary: Rescuers in Nepal are using explosives to reach hydropower workers trapped after flooding. The disaster's death toll has risen to 939 as families wait anxiously for news.

Geo-Political.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
Geo-Political.summary: US singer D4vd will now be represented by a public defender after his celebrity lawyers withdrew from his murder case. The 21-year-old has pleaded not guilty to the murder of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez.

Geo-Political.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
Geo-Political.summary: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several other people were injured during a shooting at a techno rave in Aarau, Switzerland. A man has been arrested in connection with the attack.

Geo-Political.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
Geo-Political.summary: A ferry carrying migrants sank off the coast of northern Cyprus, resulting in eight deaths and 20 missing people. Among the missing are the two young children of Ayten and Hayri Bicer.

Geo-Political.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
Geo-Political.summary: The United States and Iran have traded military strikes for the first time in weeks. A U.S. attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz killed two people and injured two others.

Geo-Political.title: US Supreme Court clears way for Trump to keep building White House ballroom
Geo-Political.summary: The US Supreme Court has allowed Donald Trump to continue construction on a White House ballroom. Chief Justice John Roberts dissented, stating that the construction is likely unlawful.

Data & Insights.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey warns that rapidly advancing artificial intelligence poses the most immediate cyber threat to the global financial system. He stated that AI could help attackers quickly identify and exploit vulnerabilities across financial institutions and critical infrastructure.

Data & Insights.summary: The finance ministry warned that global bond yields and inflation pose risks to India's economy amid external headwinds. Despite these challenges, domestic economic activity remained strong and the external sector stayed stable in August.

India.summary: Anna Hazare is currently under constant observation in the ICU under the care of Gautam Bhansali.

India.title: 25-Year-Old Man Arrested For Killing Wife Over Dowry In UP
India.summary: A 25-year-old man in Uttar Pradesh was arrested for allegedly killing his wife following dowry harassment. The arrest came after the victim's father, Ram Ghulam, filed a written police complaint on August 28.

India.title: Akali-BJP Experiment Gets Students' Stamp Ahead Of Punjab Polls
India.summary: ABVP candidate Ankit Vidhan won the Panjab University Campus Students Council presidential election. The victory came with the backing of the Shiromani Akali Dal's student wing, the Students Organisation of India.

India.title: Bihar Couple, 3 Children Injured In Acid Attack Over Financial Dispute
India.summary: A couple and their three children were injured in an acid attack during a financial dispute in Bihar's Purani Bazar locality on August 29. Police stated the incident followed a heated argument between the two sides over a monetary transaction.

India.title: 8-Year Jail For Conman Sukesh Chandrasekhar For Posing As Top Court Judge
India.summary: Conman Sukesh Chandrasekhar has been sentenced to eight years in prison for impersonating a top court judge. The sentencing court described the crime as profoundly disturbing because it targeted the judiciary, a foundational pillar of democracy.

India.title: Who To Blame For Indore's Water Deaths? 600-Page Report Has Answers
India.summary: A retired High Court judge has completed an investigation into the contaminated-water incident in Bhagirathpura. The findings are detailed in a 600-page report by the one-member judicial commission.

General.title: Mel Stride and Priti Patel replaced in major Tory reshuffle
General.summary: Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch has replaced Mel Stride and Priti Patel in a major shadow cabinet reshuffle. The changes come ahead of the party's upcoming conference in October.

General.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
General.summary: Rescuers in Nepal used explosives to reach trapped hydropower workers as the national flooding death toll reached 939. Families anxiously awaited news of their loved ones at the disaster site.

General.title: Messi retires from international football with 'nothing left to give'
General.summary: Argentina great Lionel Messi has retired from international football. He stated that the decision hurts, but he feels he has nothing left to give the national team.

General.title: Hundreds remember Heaton Park synagogue attack victims at memorial event
General.summary: Hundreds of people attended a memorial event for the victims of the Heaton Park synagogue attack. The gathering took place nearly a year after the attack and featured speeches from the chief rabbi and Angela Rayner.

General.title: AI could cause global economic downturn, Bank of England chief warns
General.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey warned that artificial intelligence could trigger a global economic downturn. He cited potential volatility stemming from energy shocks caused by the ongoing US-Iran conflict.

General.title: Victoria Beckham's company makes its first profit after 18 years
General.summary: Victoria Beckham's fashion and beauty business has recorded an operating profit of £7.3 million. This marks the company's first annual profit after 18 years of previous losses.
